_about: World-layer configuration. The physics core works in METRES; this file fixes the mapping to screen pixels and everything the procedural world generator needs. Chunk size is specified in pixels (per the world-layer spec) and converted to metres with pixels_per_metre.

terrain._todo: noise_scale and the thresholds are tuned by eye; verify visually before shipping a map.

roads._mode_help: mode='straight' builds ONE endless straight road along the lattice row straight_row (world y = straight_row * grid_spacing_m): the centreline is exactly straight, there are no junctions, and every other road key is ignored. mode='grid' restores the procedural lattice network described by grid_spacing_m, node_jitter_m and the edge probabilities.
roads._todo: grid_spacing_m controls road density; raise it for open country, lower it for a city.

props._enabled_help: enabled=false removes ALL scenery (no trees, no buildings) and skips the candidate lattice entirely; the road-clearance, interpenetration and tree-in-building rules below then never run. Set it back to true to restore the procedural scenery - every tuning key below still applies.
props._todo: Densities are spawn probabilities per prop_grid cell; tune against the FPS budget.
